subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Samuel has been up here four hours and has said about eleven words. Roberta has said the rest, all of them to a game of washers scratched into a spare console panel, which she is losing. "No. No, no, no! Where did that one come from, I didn't see that, that's a goddamn ambush!" Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
card: soc.stones, version halloran+estrada (js/content-social-alt.js; tests and effects in js/content-social.js)
notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Washers). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
